# @discord-selfbot/core 14.0.3 — Agent docs

Version-matched documentation for coding agents. Read this file first, then open the page for the task. The reference is generated from the public typings; exact types stay in `typings/index.d.ts`.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md block](./AGENTS.md): Copy this block into the project AGENTS.md before coding.
- [Introduction](./index.md): A Bun-first, TypeScript selfbot library with a discord.js v14-compatible API.
- [Installation](./getting-started/installation.md): Install @discord-selfbot/core with Bun and confirm the runtime version.
- [Token safety](./getting-started/token-safety.md): Treat a user token as a password. Read this before you connect.
- [First client](./getting-started/first-client.md): Connect with a user token, listen for events, and shut down cleanly.
- [Coding agents](./getting-started/agents.md): Give coding agents the version-matched @discord-selfbot/core docs.
- [Migrating from v13](./getting-started/migration-v13.md): Rename the package, update the runtime, and move to the v14 names.

## Guides

- [Account and profile](./guides/account-profile.md): Change presence, edit the profile, and manage friend invites.
- [Calls](./guides/calls.md): Ring a DM or group call, follow CallState events, and handle message requests.
- [Client and events](./guides/client-events.md): Configure the client, listen for gateway events, and read the connection state.
- [Errors](./guides/errors.md): Tell 401s from 500s. Retry only what is retryable.
- [Guilds](./guides/guilds.md): Fetch members, search, edit settings, and read guild metadata.
- [Interactions](./guides/interactions.md): Register slash commands, handle components and modals, and collect responses.
- [Messages](./guides/messages.md): Send, edit, react, search, and manage message state.
- [Proxies](./guides/proxies.md): Route REST traffic through HTTP or SOCKS5 proxies on Bun.
- [Rate limits](./guides/rate-limits.md): Bounded 429 retries and exact backoff fields.
- [Recording](./guides/recording.md): Record audio and video through ffmpeg without leaking processes.
- [REST-only use](./guides/rest-only.md): Call the HTTP API with a user token and no gateway connection.
- [Voice](./guides/voice.md): Join a voice channel, play media, and clean up the connection.

## Examples

- [Basic client](./examples/basic-client.md): Connect with a user token and reply to a ping message.
- [Events and partials](./examples/events.md): Enable partials, read the gateway status, and handle both ready event names.
- [Examples](./examples/index.md): Runnable TypeScript and JavaScript examples.
- [Presence](./examples/presence.md): Set a custom status and a game activity after login.
- [Slash commands](./examples/slash-commands.md): Register application commands from a selfbot client.

## API reference

- [API reference](./reference/index.md): Public runtime surface, grouped by area.

### Client

- [BaseClient](./reference/client/base-client.md): The base class for all clients.
- [Client](./reference/client/client.md): The main hub for interacting with the Discord API, and the starting point for any bot.
- [createRestClient](./reference/client/create-rest-client.md): createRestClient reference.
- [WebhookClient](./reference/client/webhook-client.md): The webhook client.
- [WebSocketManager](./reference/client/web-socket-manager.md): The WebSocket manager for this client. This class forwards raw dispatch events, read more about it here https://discord.com/developers/do...
- [WebSocketShard](./reference/client/web-socket-shard.md): Represents a Shard's WebSocket connection

### Structures

- [Activity](./reference/structures/activity.md): Activity reference.
- [AnonymousGuild](./reference/structures/anonymous-guild.md): Bundles common attributes and methods between Guild and InviteGuild
- [Application](./reference/structures/application.md): Represents an OAuth2 Application.
- [ApplicationCommand](./reference/structures/application-command.md): Represents an application command.
- [ApplicationRoleConnectionMetadata](./reference/structures/application-role-connection-metadata.md): Role connection metadata object for an application.
- [AttachmentBuilder](./reference/structures/attachment-builder.md): Represents an attachment builder.
- [AutocompleteInteraction](./reference/structures/autocomplete-interaction.md): Represents an autocomplete interaction.
- [AutoModerationActionExecution](./reference/structures/auto-moderation-action-execution.md): Represents the structure of an executed action when an AutoModerationRule is triggered.
- [AutoModerationRule](./reference/structures/auto-moderation-rule.md): Represents an auto moderation rule.
- [Base](./reference/structures/base.md): Represents a data model that is identifiable by a Snowflake (i.e. Discord API data models).
- [BaseGuild](./reference/structures/base-guild.md): The base class for Guild, OAuth2Guild and InviteGuild.
- [BaseGuildEmoji](./reference/structures/base-guild-emoji.md): Parent class for GuildEmoji and GuildPreviewEmoji.
- [BaseGuildTextChannel](./reference/structures/base-guild-text-channel.md): Represents a text-based guild channel on Discord.
- [BaseGuildVoiceChannel](./reference/structures/base-guild-voice-channel.md): Represents a voice-based guild channel on Discord.
- [ButtonInteraction](./reference/structures/button-interaction.md): Represents a button interaction.
- [CategoryChannel](./reference/structures/category-channel.md): Represents a guild category channel on Discord.
- [Channel](./reference/structures/channel.md): Represents any channel on Discord.
- [ClientPresence](./reference/structures/client-presence.md): Represents the client's presence.
- [ClientUser](./reference/structures/client-user.md): Represents the logged in client's Discord user.
- [Collector](./reference/structures/collector.md): Abstract class for defining a new Collector.
- [CommandInteraction](./reference/structures/command-interaction.md): Represents a command interaction.
- [CommandInteractionOptionResolver](./reference/structures/command-interaction-option-resolver.md): A resolver for command interaction options.
- [ContainerComponent](./reference/structures/container-component.md): ContainerComponent reference.
- [CustomStatus](./reference/structures/custom-status.md): CustomStatus reference.
- [DirectoryChannel](./reference/structures/directory-channel.md): Represents a channel that displays a directory of guilds.
- [DMChannel](./reference/structures/dm-channel.md): Represents a direct message channel between two users.
- [Emoji](./reference/structures/emoji.md): Represents an emoji, see GuildEmoji and ReactionEmoji.
- [FileComponent](./reference/structures/file-component.md): FileComponent reference.
- [ForumChannel](./reference/structures/forum-channel.md): Represents a forum channel.
- [GroupDMChannel](./reference/structures/group-dm-channel.md): Represents a Group DM Channel on Discord.
- [Guild](./reference/structures/guild.md): Represents a guild (or a server) on Discord. It's recommended to see if a guild is available before performing operations or reading data...
- [GuildAuditLogs](./reference/structures/guild-audit-logs.md): Audit logs entries are held in this class.
- [GuildBan](./reference/structures/guild-ban.md): Represents a ban in a guild on Discord.
- [GuildChannel](./reference/structures/guild-channel.md): Represents a guild channel from any of the following: - TextChannel - VoiceChannel - CategoryChannel - NewsChannel - StoreChannel - Stage...
- [GuildEmoji](./reference/structures/guild-emoji.md): Represents a custom emoji.
- [GuildMember](./reference/structures/guild-member.md): Represents a member of a guild on Discord.
- [GuildPreview](./reference/structures/guild-preview.md): Represents the data about the guild any bot can preview, connected to the specified guild.
- [GuildPreviewEmoji](./reference/structures/guild-preview-emoji.md): Represents an instance of an emoji belonging to a public guild obtained through Discord's preview endpoint.
- [GuildScheduledEvent](./reference/structures/guild-scheduled-event.md): Represents a scheduled event in a Guild.
- [GuildTemplate](./reference/structures/guild-template.md): Represents the template for a guild.
- [Integration](./reference/structures/integration.md): Represents a guild integration.
- [IntegrationApplication](./reference/structures/integration-application.md): Represents an Integration's OAuth2 Application.
- [InteractionCollector](./reference/structures/interaction-collector.md): Collects interactions. Will automatically stop if the message (Client#event:messageDelete messageDelete or Client#event:messageDeleteBulk...

### Managers

- [ApplicationCommandManager](./reference/managers/application-command-manager.md): Manages API methods for application commands and stores their cache.
- [ApplicationCommandPermissionsManager](./reference/managers/application-command-permissions-manager.md): Manages API methods for permissions of Application Commands.
- [AutoModerationRuleManager](./reference/managers/auto-moderation-rule-manager.md): Manages API methods for auto moderation rules and stores their cache.
- [BaseGuildEmojiManager](./reference/managers/base-guild-emoji-manager.md): Holds methods to resolve GuildEmojis and stores their cache.
- [BaseManager](./reference/managers/base-manager.md): Manages the API methods of a data model.
- [CachedManager](./reference/managers/cached-manager.md): Manages the API methods of a data model with a mutable cache of instances.
- [ChannelManager](./reference/managers/channel-manager.md): A manager of channels belonging to a client
- [DataManager](./reference/managers/data-manager.md): Manages the API methods of a data model along with a collection of instances.
- [GuildBanManager](./reference/managers/guild-ban-manager.md): Manages API methods for GuildBans and stores their cache.
- [GuildChannelManager](./reference/managers/guild-channel-manager.md): Manages API methods for GuildChannels and stores their cache.
- [GuildEmojiManager](./reference/managers/guild-emoji-manager.md): Manages API methods for GuildEmojis and stores their cache.
- [GuildEmojiRoleManager](./reference/managers/guild-emoji-role-manager.md): Manages API methods for roles belonging to emojis and stores their cache.
- [GuildForumThreadManager](./reference/managers/guild-forum-thread-manager.md): Manages API methods for threads in forum channels and stores their cache.
- [GuildInviteManager](./reference/managers/guild-invite-manager.md): Manages API methods for GuildInvites and stores their cache.
- [GuildManager](./reference/managers/guild-manager.md): Manages API methods for Guilds and stores their cache.
- [GuildMemberManager](./reference/managers/guild-member-manager.md): Manages API methods for GuildMembers and stores their cache.
- [GuildMemberRoleManager](./reference/managers/guild-member-role-manager.md): Manages API methods for roles of a GuildMember and stores their cache.
- [GuildScheduledEventManager](./reference/managers/guild-scheduled-event-manager.md): Manages API methods for GuildScheduledEvents and stores their cache.
- [GuildStickerManager](./reference/managers/guild-sticker-manager.md): Manages API methods for Guild Stickers and stores their cache.
- [GuildTextThreadManager](./reference/managers/guild-text-thread-manager.md): Manages API methods for ThreadChannel objects and stores their cache.
- [MessageManager](./reference/managers/message-manager.md): Manages API methods for Messages and holds their cache.
- [PermissionOverwriteManager](./reference/managers/permission-overwrite-manager.md): Manages API methods for guild channel permission overwrites and stores their cache.
- [PresenceManager](./reference/managers/presence-manager.md): Manages API methods for Presences and holds their cache.
- [ReactionManager](./reference/managers/reaction-manager.md): Manages API methods for reactions and holds their cache.
- [ReactionUserManager](./reference/managers/reaction-user-manager.md): Manages API methods for users who reacted to a reaction and stores their cache.
- [RelationshipManager](./reference/managers/relationship-manager.md): Manages API methods for Relationships and stores their cache.
- [RoleManager](./reference/managers/role-manager.md): Manages API methods for roles and stores their cache.
- [SessionManager](./reference/managers/session-manager.md): Manages API methods for users and stores their cache.
- [StageInstanceManager](./reference/managers/stage-instance-manager.md): Manages API methods for StageInstance objects and holds their cache.
- [ThreadManager](./reference/managers/thread-manager.md): Manages API methods for ThreadChannel objects and stores their cache.
- [ThreadMemberManager](./reference/managers/thread-member-manager.md): Manages API methods for GuildMembers and stores their cache.
- [UserManager](./reference/managers/user-manager.md): Manages API methods for users and stores their cache.
- [UserNoteManager](./reference/managers/user-note-manager.md): Manages API methods for Client and stores their cache.
- [VoiceStateManager](./reference/managers/voice-state-manager.md): Manages API methods for VoiceStates and stores their cache.
- [WidgetManager](./reference/managers/widget-manager.md): Manages profile widgets and widget configuration reads for the current user.

### REST

- [createProxyFetch](./reference/rest/create-proxy-fetch.md): createProxyFetch reference.
- [deriveRoute](./reference/rest/derive-route.md): deriveRoute reference.
- [DiscordAPIError](./reference/rest/discord-api-error.md): Represents an error from the Discord API.
- [HTTPError](./reference/rest/http-error.md): Represents an HTTP error from a request.
- [MissingTokenError](./reference/rest/missing-token-error.md): Thrown before any HTTP is sent when no usable token is set. Never retried.
- [OAuth2RoleConnection](./reference/rest/o-auth2-role-connection.md): Reads and writes application role connections with an OAuth2 access token.
- [parseProxyUrl](./reference/rest/parse-proxy-url.md): parseProxyUrl reference.
- [RateLimitError](./reference/rest/rate-limit-error.md): Represents a RateLimit error from a request.

## Events

- [Event catalog](./events/index.md): Events emitted by public classes.
